platformTests.skippedReason: both need ULPIN_DOCUMENT_RUNTIME_TEST_PYTHON (a native interpreter), which is not set here

defects.test: doctor takes the runtime name: a refused name reads nothing, a rehearsal name reads only its own
defects.cause: the test assumed ulpin-reh-01 has no folder on the machine; once it exists the doctor reads its real configuration and Docker, so the output changed. The doctor was correct.
defects.fix: the test runs the doctor under a preload that hides the runtimes folder, so it no longer depends on which runtimes exist

defects.cause: roll always ran its force-recreate step, with no check of what geo and worker already ran
defects.fix: roll compares the processors with the pin by the doctor's own check (processorImageProblems); when nothing differs it prints one line and runs no compose step; otherwise it behaves as before
defects.testedBy: rollNeeded in processor-image.test.mjs (no Docker); the roll itself was not run, by rule
